notes.title: Updates and Plans for the near future
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677138/7f7acca2e5add9d28acafb98d9ed39c2e13a74b6.png"][/img][/p][h1]Development Update:[/h1][p][/p][p]This past month has seen the addition of new vehicular and infantry enemies, as well as several improvements to how AI squads work and AI spawning in the world in general. In the next month, I plan to finalize a small section of the map and to implement a new inventory system.[/p][p]I have also taken some time to create a discord for the game so that I can more easily post updates and communicate with players. [/p][p]I am planning to release a fully Co-Op Demo sometime in the next 2 months. As I grow closer to completing it, I will post development updates in the discord channel. Which you can join here: [url="https://discord.gg/anqx5D7ZNU"]https://discord.gg/anqx5D7ZNU[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: First Announcement - New Unit Types
notes.notes: [p]For my first community update, I would like to show off two character models that I have recently finished[/p][p]First being the Elite Trooper[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677138/3b6b8a3da4f9fdf87a5f7640e994130e84602231.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677138/e3aedbeba35043deb63d3d155632d8237a1a6c83.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Second is the Operator[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677138/c36210f0c8a3577bc50021d953e9dcedd80f347e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677138/fd75201712c224c4c97d2c69e1220c00ee1660ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]My focus for the next two weeks will be overhauling the game's AI character behavior, and optimizing them so that I can have large numbers of AI soldiers in the game causing chaos in the world for each other and the player.[/p][p][/p][p]More coming soon![/p]
